title: Mike Rogers Campaign Spokesperson Is a Registered Agent for Israel, Documents Show
author: Jacqueline Sweet
content:

Haley Stevens, a Michigan Democrat defeated by Abdul El-Sayed in the Senate
primary, as she endorses Rogers after attending the Perfecting Church in
Detroit, Michigan November 1, 2026. REUTERS/Rebecca Cook.

Abigail Ronson, a spokesperson for the Mike Rogers campaign, is a registered
foreign agent for the state of Israel--one of two foreign agents working on
the Rogers campaign, according to a review of foreign agent registration
records.

Ronson, a ubiquitous presence on the campaign trail and in interactions with
reporters, has been working on the Rogers campaign through major vendor
Convergence Media. The campaign has paid Convergence millions this election
cycle, according to FEC reports.

Ronson, who used to work for Senate Majority Speaker Mike Johnson, is a
digital communications specialist at Convergence. In a May FARA filing, she
also registered as a foreign agent for Israel, doing work for HAVAS Media
Network via Brad Parscale's Clocktower X LLC.

Ronson was spotted Sunday behind Rogers and former Democratic contender for
the seat Rep. Haley Stevens at a press conference on Sunday after Stevens's
surprise endorsement of Rogers over Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed.

Ronson is joined by at least one other Israeli agent on the campaign: Jesse
Stokes is another Convergence Media staffer who registered as a foreign agent
[in October](https://efile.fara.gov/docs/7649-Supplemental-
Statement-20260518-1.pdf) 2025 as part of the Havas contract. Stokes appears
to pen many of Rogers' press releases, and is the author on the April press
releases announcing his Senate run, according to the document metadata.

Neither Ronson nor Stokes responded immediately to a request for comment. A
second Rogers' spokesperson, not on the Israeli payroll, did not immediately
respond to questions as to whether the campaign was aware of the arrangement.

Ronson was reportedly responsible for the ["buff" AI Mike Rogers
photo](https://www.detroitnews.com/videos/news/politics/2026/06/03/buff-ai-
image-of-mike-rogers-goes-viral/90387700007/) that went viral earlier this
year. She also helped organize a press conference for the "Democrats For Mike
Rogers" group of allegedly disillusioned Democratic voters--which, according
to Drop Site reporting, [appears to
be](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/democrats-mike-rogers-michigan) a sloppy,
astroturfed campaign.

Ronson is one of 14 Convergence staffers subcontracted by former Trump
campaign manager Brad Parscale to [push pro-Israel
views](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/israel-brad-parscale-ai-chatbots-gaza)
on social media and even seed LLMs with pro-Israel information, all part of a
$46.5 million contract with the Israel government. Convergence is ​a "campaign
strategy, digital, public affairs & media firm" led by longtime GOP operative
and Parscale ally, Mike Shields. Parscale's Israel work is paid through Havas
Media Network, and has created AI text message campaigns, and launched paid
ads on Parscale's media network Salem Media.

Ronson's registration says the services will include "strategic
communications, planning, and media services in support of Havas' engagement
by the State of Israel to develop and execute a nationwide campaign in the
United States to combat anti-semitism."

The Rogers campaign [denied
](https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/2026/06/03/mike-rogers-ai-
buff-image/90383406007/)Ronson was a staffer in June when she was identified
as making the AI muscular Rogers image, and there are no direct FEC payments
to her from the campaign. But she has been making statements as a campaign
spokesperson to media outlets--including to Drop Site News, using an official
Rogers campaign email address, and the New York Times--as recently as this
week. That email address also appears in the metadata of a PDF document posted
by the campaign website, announcing the launch of "Democrats for Mike Rogers"
in August.

The treasurer for the super PAC funding Democrats for Mike Rogers Karen
Whitsett appeared on Lara Trump's Fox show this weekend, billed only as a
disaffected Michigan voter. That super PAC, Together for Michigan, has spent
$5 million attacking El-Sayed. It has received money from Republican political
appointees such as Mara Saad ($100,000), Trump megadonor Anthony Soave
($100,000) and top Michigan Republican megadonor Robert Penske ($250,000), and
the Great Lakes Conservatives Fund--which is reportedly itself due for a $9
million infusion of cash from AIPAC, according to[ The New York
Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/21/us/politics/aipac-michigan-senate-
rogers-donation.html). The Great Lakes Conservatives Fund, which makes up the
single biggest source of funding for "Democrats for Mike Rogers," chipping in
more than $4 million so far, has a history working with an AI company run by
Parscale that [he uses](https://responsiblestatecraft.org/brad-parscale-
israel/) for his Israeli FARA work, Eyesover LLC.

_Ryan Grim contributed reporting_
